title: Approve operations plan, launch criteria and confined self-hosted runner
decision: Adopt the operations plan with thirteen launch criteria; best-effort availability, no external alerting, no automated backups; deploy through a confined self-hosted GitHub runner (ADR-015)
context: Owner prefers automatic deploys; GitHub warns against self-hosted runners on public repositories; confinement measures and a negative test mitigate the risk
chosen_option: Confined self-hosted runner with a manual fallback script
rationale: Owner decision with explicit risk acknowledgement and compensating controls recorded as launch criterion 13
